title: Check if Number Has Equal Digit Count and Digit Value
summary: Given a string num of digit characters, verify that each digit's value matches its frequency in the string.
statement: Given a string num of digit characters, verify that each digit's value matches its frequency in the string. If every digit i appears exactly num[i] times, return true; otherwise, return false.
constraints: For every index i in num, interpret num[i] as the required count of digit str(i).
Counts refer to the whole string; indices with required zero must also be checked.
Return true only when every indexed requirement matches exactly.
hints: Count every digit character in the full string.
For each position and stored digit, compare the frequency of str(index) with int(value).
Return all(counts[str(i)] == int(num[i]) for every index i).
The conjunction checks every equality in the definition, including explicit zero counts.
editorial: The conjunction checks every equality in the definition, including explicit zero counts.

tests.explanation: Digit zero occurs once, one occurs twice, two occurs once, and three occurs zero times.
The required zero count is zero, but digit zero occurs twice, so return false.
